params.name: Items
params.description:
The last item in this list will be used to replace any of the other items in this list.

The below example will replace all Emeralds and all Diamonds with Paper
```tc
player.replaceItems(
	item('emerald'),
	item('diamond'),
	item('paper')
);
```

params.name: Block Location
params.description: Converts the block at the location to a falling block
